_doc: Send limits for the auth flows (M3 task 3.2e). CONFIG, NOT CONSTANTS: these
live here so a limit can be read, reviewed and changed per environment
without a code change, and so the value a reviewer sees is the value that
runs. The limiter reads this file; nothing hardcodes a number.
TWO LIMITS, TWO DIFFERENT JOBS. per_email stops one address being
mailbox-bombed. global is a cost backstop: a runaway loop of our own making
is at least as likely as an attacker and spends the same Postmark budget.
PER-SOURCE LIMITING IS NOT HERE, deliberately. Spray across many addresses
from one source is handled at the Cloudflare edge, defined in
config/edge-rate-limits.json and verified by the edge-rules CI job. The IP
never reaches this Worker. See the network identity doctrine in CLAUDE.md.
Windows are seconds. per_email's window is deliberately at least as long as
a sign-in link lives (15 minutes), so a household cannot outrun their own
unexpired link by asking for more.
